description: This file defines an interface for request-related exceptions within the PSR HTTP Client standard, specifically providing a method to retrieve the associated request object.

classes.name: RequestExceptionInterface
classes.description: An interface representing exceptions related to HTTP request failures, extending ClientExceptionInterface and adding a method to retrieve the associated RequestInterface.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the RequestInterface object associated with the exception, which may be different from the original request passed to the client.
